name: Valencia Town Center
summary: Valencia Town Center is Santa Clarita Valley's premier regional shopping mall, featuring national retailers, diverse dining options, and family entertainment including an IMAX theater and playgrounds. With convenient hours and a relaxed atmosphere, it serves as the community's go-to destination for shopping, dining, and entertainment.
demographics: Valencia Town Center attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic from the Santa Clarita Valley, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle-income households. The primary trade area serves young families and professionals aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, reflecting the affluent suburban character of Valencia and surrounding communities. Visitors typically include dual-income families seeking convenient shopping, dining, and entertainment options, with strong weekend traffic driven by families with children utilizing the playgrounds and IMAX theater. The center draws from a well-educated population with high homeownership rates, catering to shoppers who value both national retailers and quality dining experiences in a relaxed, accessible environment.
description: Valencia Town Center stands as Santa Clarita Valley's premier shopping destination, offering a relaxed mall experience that combines national retailers, local eateries, and family-friendly entertainment. Located at 24201 West Valencia Boulevard in Valencia, California, this regional shopping center has become a cornerstone of the community, featuring an impressive mix of stores that cater to diverse shopping needs. The center distinguishes itself with exceptional entertainment amenities, including an Edwards IMAX theater that draws moviegoers from across the valley, as well as playgrounds that make it a favorite destination for families. With operating hours that extend to 9:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, Valencia Town Center provides convenient access for both weekday shoppers and weekend visitors. The mall maintains a strong reputation with a 4.4-star rating from over 8,000 reviews, reflecting its commitment to providing quality retail experiences, diverse dining options, and engaging community events that keep visitors returning throughout the year.
